Collection Instances

`C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scene.blend` already contains a collection `Gadget` with a mesh object that uses the mesh datablock `GadgetMesh`. Create three EMPTY objects named `GadgetInstance_1`, `GadgetInstance_2`, and `GadgetInstance_3`. For each one, set `instance_type = 'COLLECTION'` and `instance_collection = bpy.data.collections['Gadget']`. Place them at distinct world positions so every pair is more than `0.5` BU apart. Preserve the existing `Gadget` collection and its `GadgetMesh`, and do not duplicate mesh data: the saved file must still contain exactly one mesh datablock overall, `GadgetMesh`. Save the result as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\answer.blend`.
